[package]
name = "bivvy"
version = "1.10.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.93"
description = "Interactive development environment setup automation"
license-file = "LICENSE"
repository = "https://github.com/bivvy-dev/bivvy"
keywords = ["cli", "setup", "development", "automation"]
categories = ["command-line-utilities", "development-tools"]

[dependencies]
# CLI framework
clap = { version = "4.5.56", features = ["derive", "env"] }

# Interactive prompts
dialoguer = "0.12.0"
console = "0.16.2"

# Progress indicators
indicatif = "0.18.3"

# Serialization
serde = { version = "1.0.228", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.149"
schemars = { version = "1.2", features = ["derive"] }

# YAML parsing
serde_yaml = "0.9"

# YAML with source location tracking (for lint error reporting)
marked-yaml = "0.8.0"

# Error handling
anyhow = "1.0.100"
thiserror = "2.0.18"

# File system (none — directory discovery and glob matching are in src/sys.rs)

# Process execution (PATH lookup is in src/sys.rs)

# HTTP client (for remote templates)
reqwest = { version = "0.13.1", default-features = false, features = ["blocking", "json", "rustls"] }

# Time handling (for state)
chrono = { version = "0.4.43", features = ["serde"] }

# Hashing (for project identification)
sha2 = "0.11"
hex = "0.4.3"

# Random number generation (in src/sys.rs via /dev/urandom / BCryptGenRandom)

# Regular expressions (for version extraction)
regex = "1"

# Logging
tracing = "0.1.44"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3.22", features = ["env-filter"] }

# Embed templates at compile time
include_dir = "0.7.4"
clap_complete = "4.5.65"

# URL handling (percent-encoding and browser opening are in src/sys.rs)

[dev-dependencies]
assert_cmd = "2.1.2"
expectrl = "0.7"
httpmock = "0.8"
insta = { version = "1.47.2", features = ["yaml", "json", "redactions"] }
predicates = "3.1.3"
tempfile = "3.24.0"
vt100 = "0.15"

[target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[features]
default = []

[profile.release]
lto = true
strip = true
codegen-units = 1
opt-level = "z"

1	//! CLI argument definitions.
2	//!
3	//! This module defines all CLI arguments using clap's derive macros.
4	//! The main entry point is the [`Cli`] struct.
5	
6	use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
7	use clap_complete::Shell;
8	use std::path::PathBuf;
9	
10	/// Bivvy - Development environment setup automation.
11	#[derive(Debug, Parser)]
12	#[command(name = "bivvy")]
13	#[command(author, version, about, long_about = None)]
14	#[command(propagate_version = true)]
15	pub struct Cli {
16	    /// Path to config file (overrides default .bivvy/config.yml)
17	    #[arg(short, long, global = true)]
18	    pub config: Option<PathBuf>,
19	
20	    /// Path to project root (overrides current directory)
21	    #[arg(short, long, global = true)]
22	    pub project: Option<PathBuf>,
23	
24	    /// Show verbose output
25	    #[arg(short, long, global = true)]
26	    pub verbose: bool,
27	
28	    /// Minimal output
29	    #[arg(short, long, global = true)]
30	    pub quiet: bool,
31	
32	    /// Disable colored output
33	    #[arg(long, global = true)]
34	    pub no_color: bool,
35	
36	    /// Enable debug logging
37	    #[arg(long, global = true)]
38	    pub debug: bool,
39	
40	    /// Trust all remote extends URLs without prompting
41	    #[arg(long, global = true)]
42	    pub trust: bool,
43	
44	    #[command(subcommand)]
45	    pub command: Option<Commands>,
46	}
47	
48	use super::commands::cache::CacheArgs;
49	use super::commands::feedback::FeedbackArgs;
50	use super::commands::snapshot::SnapshotArgs;
51	use super::commands::update::UpdateArgs;
52	
53	/// Available subcommands.
54	#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]
55	pub enum Commands {
56	    /// Run setup workflow (default if no command specified)
57	    Run(RunArgs),
58	
59	    /// Initialize Bivvy configuration for a project
60	    Init(InitArgs),
61	
62	    /// Add a template step to the configuration
63	    Add(AddArgs),
64	
65	    /// Show current setup status
66	    Status(StatusArgs),
67	
68	    /// List available steps and workflows
69	    List(ListArgs),
70	
71	    /// List available templates
72	    Templates(TemplatesArgs),
73	
74	    /// Show last run information
75	    Last(LastArgs),
76	
77	    /// Show execution history
78	    History(HistoryArgs),
79	
80	    /// Validate configuration files
81	    Lint(LintArgs),
82	
83	    /// Show resolved configuration
84	    Config(ConfigArgs),
85	
86	    /// Manage template cache
87	    Cache(CacheArgs),
88	
89	    /// Capture and manage feedback
90	    Feedback(FeedbackArgs),
91	
92	    /// Manage change check snapshots
93	    Snapshot(SnapshotArgs),
94	
95	    /// Check for and install updates
96	    Update(UpdateArgs),
97	
98	    /// Generate shell completions
99	    Completions(CompletionsArgs),
100	
101	    /// Print JSON Schema for config.yml
102	    Schema(SchemaArgs),
103	}
104	
105	/// Arguments for the `run` command.
106	#[derive(Debug, Clone, clap::Args)]
107	pub struct RunArgs {
108	    /// Workflow to run
109	    #[arg(short, long, default_value = "default")]
110	    pub workflow: String,
111	
112	    /// Run only specified steps (comma-separated)
113	    #[arg(long, value_delimiter = ',')]
114	    pub only: Vec<String>,
115	
116	    /// Skip specified steps (comma-separated)
117	    #[arg(long, value_delimiter = ',')]
118	    pub skip: Vec<String>,
119	
120	    /// How to handle skipped step dependencies
121	    #[arg(long, default_value = "skip_with_dependents")]
122	    pub skip_behavior: String,
123	
124	    /// Force re-run of specified steps (comma-separated)
125	    #[arg(short, long, value_delimiter = ',')]
126	    pub force: Vec<String>,
127	
128	    /// Force re-run of every step in the workflow, bypassing all checks
129	    /// and step-level configuration
130	    #[arg(long)]
131	    pub force_all: bool,
132	
133	    /// Resume an interrupted run
134	    #[arg(long)]
135	    pub resume: bool,
136	
137	    /// Save prompt answers for future runs
138	    #[arg(long)]
139	    pub save_preferences: bool,
140	
141	    /// Preview commands without executing
142	    #[arg(long)]
143	    pub dry_run: bool,
144	
145	    /// Discard all persisted satisfaction records and evaluate everything fresh
146	    #[arg(long)]
147	    pub fresh: bool,
148	
149	    /// Use defaults, no prompts
150	    #[arg(long)]
151	    pub non_interactive: bool,
152	
153	    /// Deprecated: use --non-interactive and --env ci instead
154	    #[arg(long, hide = true)]
155	    pub ci: bool,
156	
157	    /// Target environment (e.g., development, ci, staging)
158	    #[arg(short, long, value_name = "ENV")]
159	    pub env: Option<String>,
160	
161	    /// Use the diagnostic funnel for error recovery (overrides config)
162	    #[arg(long)]
163	    pub diagnostic_funnel: bool,
164	
165	    /// Disable the diagnostic funnel, use legacy pattern matching
166	    #[arg(long, conflicts_with = "diagnostic_funnel")]
167	    pub no_diagnostic_funnel: bool,
168	
169	    /// Suppress run header (used when chaining from init)
170	    #[arg(skip)]
171	    pub suppress_header: bool,
172	}
173	
174	impl Default for RunArgs {
175	    fn default() -> Self {
176	        Self {
177	            workflow: "default".to_string(),
178	            only: Vec::new(),
179	            skip: Vec::new(),
180	            skip_behavior: "skip_with_dependents".to_string(),
181	            force: Vec::new(),
182	            force_all: false,
183	            resume: false,
184	            save_preferences: false,
185	            dry_run: false,
186	            non_interactive: false,
187	            ci: false,
188	            env: None,
189	            diagnostic_funnel: false,
190	            no_diagnostic_funnel: false,
191	            fresh: false,
192	            suppress_header: false,
193	        }
194	    }
195	}

197	/// Arguments for the `init` command.
198	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, clap::Args)]
199	pub struct InitArgs {

201	    #[arg(long)]
202	    pub minimal: bool,
203

205	    #[arg(long)]

217	/// Arguments for the `status` command.
218	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, clap::Args)]
219	pub struct StatusArgs {
220	    /// Workflow to show status for. When provided, the workflow's
221	    /// portable steps are visible alongside the project-level ones.
222	    pub workflow: Option<String>,
223	
224	    /// Output as JSON
225	    #[arg(long)]
226	    pub json: bool,
227	
228	    /// Show status for specific step
229	    #[arg(long)]
230	    pub step: Option<String>,
231	
232	    /// Target environment (e.g., development, ci, staging)
233	    #[arg(long, value_name = "ENV")]
234	    pub env: Option<String>,
235	}
236	
237	/// Arguments for the `list` command.
238	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, clap::Args)]
239	pub struct ListArgs {
240	    /// Show details for one workflow (parses just that file).
241	    pub target: Option<String>,
242	
243	    /// List only steps
244	    #[arg(long)]
245	    pub steps_only: bool,
246	
247	    /// List only workflows
248	    #[arg(long)]
249	    pub workflows_only: bool,
250	
251	    /// Show every step and workflow from the merged configuration
252	    /// (legacy behavior). Without this flag, output is built from
253	    /// discovery + headers and does not deep-merge.
254	    #[arg(long)]
255	    pub all: bool,
256	
257	    /// Output as JSON
258	    #[arg(long)]
259	    pub json: bool,
260	
261	    /// Target environment (e.g., development, ci, staging)
262	    #[arg(long, value_name = "ENV")]
263	    pub env: Option<String>,
264	}
265	
266	/// Arguments for the `last` command.
267	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, clap::Args)]
268	pub struct LastArgs {
269	    /// Output as JSON
270	    #[arg(long)]
271	    pub json: bool,
272	
273	    /// Show details for specific step
274	    #[arg(long)]
275	    pub step: Option<String>,
276	
277	    /// Show all runs
278	    #[arg(long)]
279	    pub all: bool,
280	
281	    /// Include command output
282	    #[arg(long)]
283	    pub output: bool,
284	}
285	
286	/// Arguments for the `history` command.
287	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, clap::Args)]
288	pub struct HistoryArgs {
289	    /// Filter by step name
290	    #[arg(long)]
291	    pub step: Option<String>,
292	
293	    /// Number of runs to show
294	    #[arg(long)]
295	    pub limit: Option<usize>,
296	
297	    /// Show runs since duration (e.g., "1h", "7d", "30m")
298	    #[arg(long)]
299	    pub since: Option<String>,
300	
301	    /// Show detailed view with steps for each run
302	    #[arg(long)]
303	    pub detail: bool,
304	
305	    /// Output as JSON
306	    #[arg(long)]
307	    pub json: bool,
308	
309	    /// Delete this project's run history (only logs that belong to this
310	    /// project; logs from other projects are left untouched)
311	    #[arg(long)]
312	    pub clear: bool,
313	
314	    /// Skip the confirmation prompt when used with `--clear`
315	    #[arg(short, long)]
316	    pub force: bool,
317	}
318	
319	/// Arguments for the `lint` command.
320	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, clap::Args)]
321	pub struct LintArgs {
322	    /// Workflow or step name to lint. Resolves to .bivvy/workflows/<name>.yml
323	    /// first, then .bivvy/steps/<name>.yml.
324	    pub target: Option<String>,
325	
326	    /// Force lookup as a workflow file: .bivvy/workflows/<NAME>.yml
327	    #[arg(long, value_name = "NAME", conflicts_with_all = ["step", "config_only", "all"])]
328	    pub workflow: Option<String>,
329	
330	    /// Force lookup as a step file: .bivvy/steps/<NAME>.yml
331	    #[arg(long, value_name = "NAME", conflicts_with_all = ["workflow", "config_only", "all"])]
332	    pub step: Option<String>,
333	
334	    /// Lint .bivvy/config.yml only (the default when no target is given).
335	    /// Named `--config-only` rather than `--config` to avoid collision
336	    /// with the global `-c, --config <PATH>` option.
337	    #[arg(long = "config-only", conflicts_with_all = ["workflow", "step", "all"])]
338	    pub config_only: bool,
339	
340	    /// Lint every file in the merged state — equivalent to the legacy
341	    /// "lint everything" behavior, now opt-in
342	    #[arg(long, conflicts_with_all = ["workflow", "step", "config_only"])]
343	    pub all: bool,
344	
345	    /// Output format: human, json, sarif
346	    #[arg(long, default_value = "human")]
347	    pub format: String,
348	
349	    /// Auto-fix simple issues

352

356	}
